component.name: Image Compare
component.summary: Image comparison and visual diff tool

description.p: Image Compare is a desktop image comparison and visual diff tool for inspecting two or more images side by side, in a stacked view, or with a heatmap of perceptual differences.
Use it to compare screenshots, rendered images, exports, design revisions, before and after edits, and subtle visual differences between image versions.

ul.li: Side-by-side and stacked comparison
Grid layout when four or more images are loaded
Synchronized zoom and pan across images with different dimensions
Perceptual heatmap generation and export for two same-size images
Faithful color-profile rendering with an optional raw display mode
Multiple image formats with fast loading through Qt6 and libvips

screenshot.caption: Comparing two images side by side with a heatmap

ul.li: Enable match zoom by default when comparing images with different resolutions
Tighten gaps for a more compact comparison workspace
Improve libvips image conversion paths for display and heatmap generation
Add DEB, RPM, and Windows release builds
Fix Flatpak file paths and folder opening
Make Flatpak-specific build dependencies optional for normal builds
Fix blurry image rendering when zoomed out
Small bug fixes
Improve zooming and panning performance and eliminate flickers
Add active pane selection, focused image view, image reordering, and pane context menu actions
Add heatmap export to disk
Changed the heatmap colors and score readouts
General Bug fixes, performance and UX improvements
Use compiled QML module packaging and avoid stale user QML disk cache after updates
Use a perceptual heatmap metric based on dE00 color difference
Simplify heatmap summaries to overall (average) and hotspot (p95) dE00 values
Disable Build Heatmap while a heatmap job is processing
Fix heatmap generation failures for uncommon image band layouts
Add portal-aware drag-and-drop for Flatpak environments
Add keyboard shortcuts for open, heatmap, display mode, and zoom reset
Initial Release
